skip_reason: The CodeBuddy CLI skill requires mandatory authentication (Google/GitHub OAuth or WeChat login) to execute any meaningful AI-powered commands. All core functionality — single-task execution (`codebuddy "<prompt>"`), slash commands (`/init`, `/config`, `/status`, `/memory`), and the `-p`/`--print` mode — require an active authenticated session against Tencent's proprietary backend. This constitutes a banned 'Authenticated/Stateful Network' dependency (real OAuth login, no mock possible for a closed proprietary service). Additionally, the npm package `@tencent-ai/codebuddy-code` is a Tencent-internal tool whose public availability on the npm registry cannot be guaranteed in an isolated sandbox. The only testable surface without authentication (directory structure creation for custom commands) is too trivial to constitute a rigorous multi-step evaluation task with high discriminative power.
